items.zh: 研讨会重点介绍麻省理工学院针对老龄化大脑健康的广泛创新

items.title: Russian spacecraft maneuvers in "extreme proximity" to satellite used by Ukraine
items.summary: "Kosmos 2612 closed from hundreds of kilometers away to extreme proximity to ICEYE-X36."

items.title: Batteries help reduce emissions, but how do we reduce their emissions?
items.summary: One way to make batteries cleaner is to make fewer of them.
items.zh: 电池有助于减少排放，但我们如何减少排放呢？

items.title: Startup taps underwater volcano as energy source in "proof point" test

items.title: Why teaching AI about symmetry could make prenatal diagnosis more reliable
items.summary: A model developed by researchers at MIT and Boston Children's Hospital adjusts scans on the fly to track fetal movement, potentially sparing families repeat hospital visits.
items.zh: 为什么向人工智能教授对称性可以使产前诊断更加可靠

items.title: AI Proved the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis. What Happens Now?
items.summary: Unlike other recent AI proofs, this one has been unpacked by human experts. The implications, one mathematician said, are “staggering.” The post AI Proved the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis. What Happens Now? first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 人工智能证明了拟黎曼假设。现在发生了什么？

items.title: A Chinese rocket deorbited over Minnesota and left this in a farmer's cornfield
items.summary: All the evidence points to the debris being part of a Chinese Zhuque-2E rocket.

items.title: Giving AI a “crystal clear” view of the materials world
